about_the_game:
Leximorph is a word game like no other — where letters evolve, and strategy is key!

In this Suika-like game, drop letter-shaped tiles into a tank and watch the chaos unfold. When two of the same letter touch, they merge into the next letter in the alphabet and grow in size! Bigger letters mean fewer spaces — and less room to manoeuvre.

Use letters to form words and clear space, but choose wisely: longer words score more points!

Run out of space, and it's game over.

How long can you survive the morphing madness?

The Lexicon

The Lexicon is a bank of crossword style clues, which unlock as you play. There are over 220 words in the Lexicon - can you unlock them all?

Abilities

Abilities keep the game interesting in a variety of ways - here's a few!

  • Vowel Ball - Turns any letter it touches into a vowel.

  • Consonant Ball - Turns any letter it touches into a consonant.

  • Bomb - Detonates and destroys the letters around it.

  • Shrinker - Cuts the size of letters in half.

  • Attractor - Attracts letters nearby toward it.

  • Repeller - Repels letters nearby away from it.

Game Modes

At launch there will be 5 game modes:

  • Normal Mode - no time pressure, just don't run out of space.

  • Auto Drop - the letters drop where they please, make sure to keep clearing words so the tank doesn't fill.

  • Inflate Mode - Every letter slowly inflates over time.

  • Zone Shrink - The game over zone slowly makes its way down the screen, making words from the letters delays it, the longer the word the longer the delay!

  • Five Letter Mode - Like normal mode, except you can only submit words that are five letters in length!
